## Sequence Diagram

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant CE as Cloud Environment
    participant SA as Security Analyzer
    participant SCE as Compression Engine
    participant TG as Trust Graph Builder
    participant OP as On-Prem Fabric

    CE->>SA: Export identity providers

    SA->>SA: Parse semantic security context

    SCE->>SCE: Identify equivalent policies

    OP->>OP: Enforce local trust graph

```

They break many renderers and image export. - Use shorter labels, multiple nodes, or subgraphs instead of forcing line breaks inside one label. INVENTION: --- invention-id: invention-20260701-145222 company: IBM created: 2026-07-01T14:52:29 --- # Invention Idea Rather than migrating each cloud AI tool independently, the system first analyzes the security semantics of all AI services, models, agents, and tools used across the enterprise. It identifies equivalent authorization policies, trust relationships, data classifications, and audit requirements, then collapses them into a unified on-prem security fabric. Multiple identity providers, policy engines, and model permissions are transformed into a single semantic trust graph enforced locally. The result is an on-prem deployment with a significantly smaller attack surface than the original cloud environment, rather than simply recreating its complexity. The novelty lies in semantic security compression performed as part of the migration process.
